subject: Dragon Warrior
text: Do not rescue Princess Gwaelin initially, as beating the final boss without rescuing her is required for missable achievements.

evidence.quote: The only thing you need to keep in mind is to not rescue the princess when you get the chance to, as you need to beat the final boss once without having rescued her.

subject: Dragon Warrior
text: Before fighting the final boss for the first time, save the game, defeat him, reboot after credits, and then rescue Princess Gwaelin for the remaining missable achievements.

evidence.quote: Once you are ready to approach the final boss for the first time, save the game (optionally make a copy with the in-game feature if you want to be extra safe) and defeat him. After the credits roll and you reboot the game, you can then rescue the princess and go through the process again for the other missable achievements.

subject: Magic Key
text: The Magic Key is found by searching chests inside the King's chamber at Tantegel Castle.

evidence.quote: In the king's chamber, search every chest and find the Magic Key.

subject: Door
text: Approaching the door south of the king and using the Door command unlocks the chamber door.

evidence.quote: Approach the door south of the king, press A and select the Door option to unlock the door.

subject: Erdrick's Tablet
text: Erdrick's Tablet is found in the only chest on the second floor of a cave northwest of Tantegel Castle.

evidence.quote: Erdrick's Tablet can be found in a cave north-west on Tantegel. This cave is devoid of monsters, but as with every cave, it is dark so a torch is recommended to make progress. Head down to the second floor and you will find Erdrick's Tablet in the only chest.

subject: Magic Key
text: Magic Keys can be purchased in Rimuldar.

evidence.quote: Head to Garinham once you have at least two Magic Keys (you can purchase them in Rimuldar), and one or two torches unless you have the Illuminate spell.

subject: Garin's Grave
text: In Garinham, open the north house and hug the north black wall to find a passage leading into Garin's Grave.

evidence.quote: Open the house north and go inside, then hug the north black wall until you find the spot that lets you through a passage into Garin's Grave.

subject: Cursed Belt
text: The Cursed Belt is located in Garin's Grave.

evidence.quote: This is a cave consisting of four floors, and the Silver Harp is, unsurprisingly, at the very end. This cave also has the Cursed Belt for another achievement.

subject: Silver Harp Path
text: To reach the Silver Harp in Garin's Grave, open the right door on B1F to reach the middle staircase, navigate to the bottom-left on B2F, head north on B3F to the singular staircase, and take the middle staircase on B4F.

evidence.quote: On B1F,  open the door on the right, then make your way to the middle of the screen where the only staircase is....On B2F, make your way to the bottom-left of the screen....On B3F, go north from where you currently are, which will eventually make you end up at the singular staircase....On B4F, take the other singular staircase in the middle, then you will arrive at the Silver Harp.

subject: Stones of Sunlight
text: At Tantegel Castle, open the door in the top-right, go outside, walk down alongside the wall, move one space right, and walk down along the water to reach a staircase leading to the Stones of Sunlight.

evidence.quote: Once you have the key, head back to Tantegel Castle and go to the top-right, where you will be blocked by a door. Open this door, then go outside when you are given the option to. Walk downwards alongside the castle wall, then go one space to the right and go downwards along the water to reach a staircase. Here you will find the Stones of Sunlight.

subject: Staff of Rain
text: Giving the Silver Harp to the old man in the shrine west and up from Kol awards the Staff of Rain.

evidence.quote: The Silver Harp is required to get the Staff of Rain. Once you have this, head to Kol and then go west and up until you reach a shrine with an old man inside. Give him the Silver Harp, and the Staff of Rain is yours.

subject: Erdrick's Token
text: Erdrick's Token is hidden in the middle of the right side of the swamp located south of Cantlin.

evidence.quote: If you have the Princess' Pledge, you can call to her to find the location, which is "70 steps south, and 40 steps east" on Tantegel. You will most likely not have this if you are going for all the endings, so instead, go to the swamp south of Cantlin (you need to walk around from west). On the right side of this swamp, search for Erdrick's Token pretty much straight in the middle. Walk around here a bit and you will eventually find it.

subject: Rainbow Drop
object: Stones of Sunlight, Staff of Rain, Erdrick's Token
text: Giving the Stones of Sunlight, Staff of Rain, and Erdrick's Token to the shrine south of Rimuldar yields the Rainbow Drop.

evidence.quote: Once you have the Stones of Sunlight, the Staff of Rain, and Erdrick's Token, head south of Rimuldar towards Erdrick's Shrine. Give him the items in exchange for the Rainbow Drop.

subject: Rainbow Bridge
text: Using the Rainbow Drop at the desert northwest of Rimuldar where the other side is separated by one tile of water builds the Rainbow Bridge.

evidence.quote: With the Rainbow Drop in hand, head to the desert north-west of Rimuldar. Get to the point where the other side is separated by only one tile of water, then use the Rainbow Drop to build the Rainbow Bridge.

subject: Secret Stairs
text: Searching behind the throne in Charlock Castle reveals secret stairs needed to proceed to the Dragonlord.

evidence.quote: Go to the throne room in Charlock Castle, then stand behind the throne and search to discover the secret stairs, necessary to proceed to the Dragonlord.

subject: Dragonlord
text: Accepting the Dragonlord's offer to rule together triggers the bad ending.

evidence.quote: When you finally find the Dragonlord at the bottom of Charlock Castle, he will offer you to rule with him. Accept his offer and you will receive the bad ending.

subject: Dragonlord
text: A minimum level of 20 is recommended to defeat the Dragonlord.

evidence.quote: The Dragonlord is the final- and toughest boss of the game, so being at the very least level 20 is recommended.

subject: Dragonlord
text: The Dragonlord has two phases, the first being a mage with low defense and HP, followed by a stronger second phase.

evidence.quote: The Dragonlord has two phases, with the first one being a mage with low defense and HP so just get rid of him as quickly as possible. The second phase is stronger but still not really that bad depending on your level.

subject: Princess Gwaelin
text: Thou Art a Jerk to Women is earned by returning to the castle after defeating the Dragonlord without saving Princess Gwaelin.

evidence.quote: Thou Art a Jerk to Women (25) [achievement 13419]...Beat the Dragonlord and return to the castle without saving Gwaelin...As the description mentions, return to the castle without saving the princess.

subject: Princess Gwaelin
text: Rescuing Princess Gwaelin requires a Magic Key, a torch or Illuminate magic, and defeating a Green Dragon in the cave south of Kol.

evidence.quote: To rescue the Princess, you will need a Magic Key, a torch or Illuminate magic, and a level of around 15 is also recommended as you need to defeat a Green Dragon (but given that you will likely do this with the endings, you will be fine). Once you have all the requirements, go south of Kol into the cave connecting to the continent with Rimuldar. On the right side in this cave you will run into the dragon that appears as a random encounter, so defeat it and then open the door to find the Princess.

subject: Princess Gwaelin
text: Bringing Princess Gwaelin to Charlock Castle and speaking with the Dragonlord unlocks the Thine Princess By Thine Side achievement.

evidence.quote: Once you have rescued the Princess in the achievement above, bring her with you to Charlock Castle and head towards the Dragonlord. The achievement will trigger once you talk to him, and there will be no additional benefits- or penalties so no need to worry about that.

subject: Princess Gwaelin
text: After defeating the Dragonlord, return to Tantegel Castle with Princess Gwaelin in tow and speak to the King to see the credits.

evidence.quote: Once you have defeated the Dragonlord, head back to Tantegel Castle, talk with the king and watch the credits!

subject: Level Grinding
text: For Levels 2 and 3, defeat Slimes and Drakees outside Tantegel up to around level 5 while buying gear in Tantegel Town.

evidence.quote: Level 2 and 3: just run outside Tantegel and defeat Slimes and Drakees. Recommended is to keep this up to around level 5 while stocking up on gear/armor Tantegel Town.

subject: Level Grinding
text: To reach Level 9, purchase the best available armor in Garinham and grind around the area or in the cave to the south.

evidence.quote: Level 9: Make your way north-west of Tantegel to Garinham. Buy the best armour you can, then grind around here for a bit or to the south where a cave is, where you can get an item for another achievement. May as well kill two birds with one stone to make the grind not painful. This cave is recommended to do until level 9. If you have money to burn (3,000 gold to be exact), you can also go to the far east of Garinham to Kol, which has better armour.

subject: Goldman
text: Goldmans south of Rimuldar drop more gold than any other enemy in the game.

evidence.quote: To the south of Rimuldar are not only good enemies like the Wyvern, but also the Goldman who drops more gold than any other enemy.

subject: Level Grinding
text: Garin's Grave is recommended as a grinding spot around Level 15 while retrieving the Silver Harp and Cursed Belt.

evidence.quote: Level 15: You can either decide to stay at the Goldmans for a bit longer, or instead do some more mandatory quests, like getting the Silver Harp and Cursed Belt. The Grave of Garin also is a pretty good grinding spot for around your level, so I would personally recommend it.

subject: Cantlin Equipment
text: In Cantlin, the sword costs 9,800 gold and the shield costs 14,800 gold.

evidence.quote: If you want, you can try to push through to Cantlin, the fortress city, and see if you have enough money to upgrade you armour; 9,800 gold is needed for the sword, and 14,800 for the shield.

subject: Erdrick's Armor
text: Erdrick's Armor can be found inside the ruined town of Hauksness.

evidence.quote: Hauksness is also where you can get Erdrick's Armour, so getting this as soon as possible is recommended.

subject: Erdrick's Sword
text: Erdrick's Sword is located inside Charlock Castle.

evidence.quote: First of all, it is highly recommended to have done everything you can at this point, including getting all of Erdrick's gear (the sword is in Charlock Castle) and possibly also the Death Necklace as you will be going down the dungeon several times for it anyway.

subject: Metal Slime
text: Metal Slimes appear as rare encounters to the southwest of Hauksness and can be one-shot once at Level 24.

evidence.quote: Alternative 1: Once you are Level 24, you can one-shot Metal Slimes to the south-west of Hauksness. I generally don't recommend this as they are rare encounters and don't offer that much more exp, but if you are tired of the same environment you can at least mix it up.
